purpose: Translate the exact three-cue routeability task into a biologically learnable bumblebee-style visual apparatus without changing the formal cue architecture or introducing an access-arm timing confound.

species_scope.preferred_system: free-flying worker bumblebees with colony identity retained
species_scope.exact_species: operational/human input pending local availability and ethics
species_scope.reason: the feasibility literature for contextual visual learning, multicue discrimination and artificial-flower foraging is strongest in Bombus

q_route.implementation: large visual surround or frame that is presented before terminal access and remains visible throughout terminal-cue presentation and the final choice
forbidden: a context cue that disappears before the terminal cue
an unavoidable spatial-location cue that cannot be masked in the fixed-access arm
changing global illumination in a way that changes the appearance of terminal cues

q_left.implementation: spatially fixed terminal window whose binary outcome is a member of the same terminal-symbol family used for q_right

q_right.implementation: spatially fixed terminal window whose binary outcome is a member of the same terminal-symbol family used for q_left

contingent_B2: reveal exactly one terminal window selected by the frozen context rule
keep revealed terminal cue visible through the response
fixed_B2: keep the first terminal cue visible
reveal the second terminal cue in a state-independent counterbalanced order
keep both terminal cues visible through the response
access_timing.B3: all three cues are available in both access arms with matched persistence and total presentation opportunity
access_timing.B1: one cue is available according to the frozen budget-ladder definition
access_timing.principle: access arms differ in contingent information architecture, not in simultaneous-versus-sequential exposure or cue persistence

physical_matching.only_allowed_architecture_difference: target/reward mapping for the already frozen cue vectors
physical_matching.cue_symbol_counterbalance: use the four orthogonal bit-flip profiles already frozen in the experiment schedule so no physical symbol is permanently tied to semantic bit 0/1 or target class

architecture_neutral_material_pretest.cohort: separate pretest/pilot animals or pre-randomization apparatus cohort; never use confirmatory treatment performance to select cue materials
architecture_neutral_material_pretest.task: test each binary cue identity as a simple two-choice differential discrimination outside the routeability architecture
architecture_neutral_material_pretest.admission_criterion_each_cue: at least 80% correct in the last 20 scored choices
architecture_neutral_material_pretest.salience_balance_rule: after all three cue identities meet the 80% criterion, the absolute difference between best and worst final-20 accuracy must be <= 0.10; otherwise redesign the physical materials before confirmatory allocation
architecture_neutral_material_pretest.failure_policy: replace or resize symbols and repeat the architecture-neutral material pretest; do not exclude randomized confirmatory individuals because one architecture is harder
architecture_neutral_material_pretest.interpretation: the 80% rule is an apparatus/cue qualification criterion, not the confirmatory routeability endpoint or power target

overshadowing_control.problem: bumblebees can preferentially learn the most salient or easiest element in multicomponent visual stimuli
controls: qualify each cue identity separately before compound training
avoid one trivially discriminable color contrast paired with much harder shape/pattern contrasts
record cue-role-specific acquisition diagnostics during the procedural pilot
do not change cue salience after confirmatory data are opened

odor_and_side_controls.odor: physical cue surfaces must not carry cue-specific scent; clean/reuse materials under one frozen protocol
odor_and_side_controls.side: terminal-window side is a query identity, not a reward predictor; reward mapping and first-fixed-cue order are counterbalanced independently of side
odor_and_side_controls.scent_marking: clean contacted artificial-flower surfaces between bouts or use replaceable neutral covers

literature_rationale.citation: Dale et al. 2005, J Exp Biol
literature_rationale.role: bumblebee contextual learning is substantially stronger when contextual cues are concurrent/persistent than when a priming cue is only briefly presented before the target

literature_rationale.citation: Learning modifies attention during bumblebee visual search, Behav Ecol Sociobiol 2024
literature_rationale.role: example of an 80%-correct-in-last-20-choices visual discrimination criterion

literature_rationale.citation: Bumble bee visual learning: simple solutions for complex stimuli, Animal Behaviour 2025
literature_rationale.role: multicomponent visual learning can show salience-driven generalization and overshadowing
Bombus terrestris changes multicue learning strategy with cue discriminability; supports explicit salience control rather than assuming all visual cues are equally learned

human_material_inputs_still_required: exact bumblebee species and colony source
spectral reflectance or display calibration where colour is used
cleaning materials compatible with the local apparatus
promotion_rule: Do not freeze exact physical colors/patterns into the confirmatory schedule until the architecture-neutral material pretest passes. Once passed, hash the material specification and do not alter cue identities after confirmatory allocation.
claim_ceiling: This gate establishes biological plausibility and confound control for the physical cue architecture. It does not establish that a particular local material set is learnable until the architecture-neutral pretest is run, and it does not supply pilot nuisance parameters, final N, ethics approval, or an empirical routeability result.
